supraorbital_contour.lateral_prominence: The ridge extends significantly beyond the lateral margin of the orbital socket, creating a pronounced 2D shelf visible in profile.

macro_zonal_melanin_distribution.regional_intensity_contrast: Uniformly high melanin concentration across the face; there is negligible pixel intensity contrast between the muzzle and the periocular/cheek regions.

maxillary_and_labial_geometry.resting_lip_thickness: The lower lip exhibits a visible structural droop and moderate 2D vertical thickness in a resting state.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A prominent, irregularly shaped white depigmented patch or scar is located on the bridge of the nose.
other_distinctive_markers: The localized white pigmentation on the nasal bridge is the primary identifying marker.
